metadata.research_scope: Public web pages retrieved on the validation date; sources include official company/program/investor pages and selected independent startup/funding press. No external LLM was used. No paid databases were accessed.
metadata.caveat: A missing public funding announcement is not proof that no private or undisclosed investment exists. The no_public_round_found and grant_only_no_public_round_found statuses are not assigned without the required multi-source search evidence.

candidates.name: Additive Drives
candidates.funding_summary: The EXIST story reports a mid-double-digit-million financing in early 2026 without stating currency, instrument, stage or investors. AM Ventures confirms an investor relationship dating to October 2020, but its page does not establish a specific round. No round terms are asserted.

public_grants_and_support.name: EXIST-Forschungstransfer
public_grants_and_support.details: EXIST support is described as enabling early R&D and company formation.

sources.title: EXIST success story: Additive Drives
sources.claim: Official program success story identifies the company, describes its technology and discusses the research-to-company transition and public EXIST support.

sources.title: Additive Drives portfolio profile
sources.claim: Investor portfolio page identifies Additive Drives as a portfolio company, says it joined in October 2020 and names Nordic Alpha Partners as co-investor.

open_questions: The early-2026 financing type, currency, amount and participating investors are not reported in detail.
A company website URL was not confirmed from an accessible source during this review.
